title: LiDAR-Based Multi-Modal UAV Navigation Dataset for Robust Benchmarking in Complex-Structured, GNSS-Denied Industrial Environments
authors: Qiu Z.; Lin D.; Liu B.; Han H.; Guo W.; Liang J.; Chen Z.; Yan Z.; Wang H.; Yang X.; Liu Z.; Zhao L.
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.

methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using LiDAR_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
